HeirsOfEarth.NationDef.label: League of Hellas
HeirsOfEarth.NationDef.description: The colony ship Argo carried teachers, doctors and philosophers, and their children never stopped arguing. The city-states of Hellas are a quarrelsome league held together by a common tongue, the games and a deep love of learning. Their hoplites fight shoulder to shoulder, their physicians are sought by every nation, and they count the Nova Romans as old friends.

doctrine.label: phalanx
doctrine.description: Hoplites fight shoulder to shoulder, each shield covering the man to the left. In the line they are hard to hit and hard to escape; alone they are ordinary men.
